## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The exclusion flag should honor its environment default so CI jobs can filter archives without passing the flag explicitly.

## Changes

The pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag that matches file names before adding them to the archive. It documents the flag, logs skipped files in verbose mode, and adds tests for parsing, filtering, and archive contents.

## Critical

(none)

## Important

- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Honor `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` as the flag default — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and no `--exclude` argument, the parser returns an empty list. `.agents/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11` requires that “Every command-line flag added under `cli/` from now on must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable”. — CI jobs that set exclusions through the environment will include matching files in their archives.

## Suggestions

- cli/main.py:33 — tests — Cover exact-name exclusions in nested directories — With `--exclude skip.log` and a file at `nested/skip.log`, a regression that matches against the full path would include the file and still pass every test. The filtering tests use wildcard patterns that also match full paths. — A regression in basename matching could reach users who exclude specific file names from nested directories. — Fix: Extend `test_main_leaves_excluded_files_out_of_the_archive` with an exact-name pattern and a nested file.
